Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped to anywhere in the US in 1-3 working days on average.

All orders come with tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleececompany.com.

settings.text: We won’t rest until you're completely happy with your Muslin Pajama.
Made from lightweight muslin cotton, this cherry-print pajama set feels soft, breezy, and smooth on the skin. The playful design adds a fresh charm perfect for warm nights and laid-back mornings.
